body:
version: '1'
kind: miner
id: 302
slug: chainsight-oracle
protocol: generic
name: ChainSight — On-Chain Intelligence Hub
description: 'A single authoritative oracle for real-time on-chain and market intelligence: crypto prices,
  market cap and volume, DeFi TVL, fiat exchange rates, network gas prices, wallet balances and transaction
  lookups across Ethereum and Base. Every answer is number-first, canonical and independently reproducible
  — sourced from professional public feeds (CoinGecko, DefiLlama, public RPC, exchange-rate feeds) and
  recorded on Telegraph as a hashed, verifiable signal. Purpose-built for trading, risk and analytics
  agents that need one reliable endpoint for the full on-chain data surface. Accepts explicit params or
  a plain-language question and returns the exact figure with a concise statement.

  '
base_url: https://hub.shadrakbessanh.me
auth:
  type: none
rate_limit_per_sec: 5
cache_ttl_sec: 30
circuit_threshold: 5
circuit_cooldown_seconds: 30
input_schema:
  type: object
  properties:
    symbol:
      type: string
      description: Asset ticker or name, e.g. BTC, ethereum.
    protocol:
      type: string
      description: DeFi protocol slug, e.g. aave, uniswap.
    chain:
      type: string
      description: 'Chain name: ethereum or base.'
    base:
      type: string
      description: Base fiat currency code, e.g. EUR.
    quote:
      type: string
      description: Quote fiat currency code, e.g. USD.
    address:
      type: string
      description: 0x wallet address (40 hex).
    hash:
      type: string
      description: 0x transaction hash (64 hex).
    query:
      type: string
      description: Natural-language question if params are not supplied.
    intent:
      type: string
      description: Optional intent hint.
output_schema:
  type: object
  properties:
    signal:
      type: string
      description: Concise canonical answer (number-first).
    price_usd:
      type: number
    market_cap_usd:
      type: number
    volume_24h_usd:
      type: number
    tvl_usd:
      type: number
    rate:
      type: number
    gas_price_gwei:
      type: number
    balance_eth:
      type: number
    value_eth:
      type: number
    source:
      type: string
semantics:
  signal_mapping:
    label_field: signal
    reason_field: source
  supported_intents:
  - ACADEMIC_SEARCH_GENERAL
  - AGENT_TASK_GENERAL

  - CONTRACT_OBLIGATION_AUDIT_GENERAL
